# Letter: sources for the drainage survey

Thank you for asking which studies the drainage survey relied on. The field team used the reports below; copies are held in the project library and may be borrowed for two weeks.

References: ⟦PERSON|Penrow, J. L.⟧ 1971. ⟦PERSON|Ostrand, D. J.⟧, and ⟦PERSON|Brannock, E. E.⟧ 1969. ⟦PERSON|Draycott,D.P.⟧ 1970.

Further reading held in the library:

- ⟦PERSON|Alvarne, L. J.⟧ 1968. Notes on clay soils.
- ⟦PERSON|Quessel, Mira⟧. 1972. Drainage of upland pasture.

The 1969 study measured runoff on two slopes only, so its figures were used for comparison and not as a baseline. The 1971 report gives the soil classes adopted in section 3 of the survey.

Further questions about the sources can be raised at the next project meeting.
